C1414.title: Polymarket UMA Oracle Manipulation Incident
C1414.summary: In March 2025, a whale holding a large amount of UMA tokens forcibly validated an incorrect outcome during the dispute resolution phase of a Polymarket prediction market on whether Ukraine would agree to Trump's mineral deal by April. This manipulated a market that should have resolved to zero into a 100% probability, exposing the manipulability of token-based oracle governance mechanisms.
